Four-state transfer sums all proper colorings. uint64_t arithmetic evaluates exactly modulo 2^64. The complete lex-reversal enumeration has (C(198,4)+4851)/2=31,060,953 distinct types; each unordered_map key compares both residues exactly and no same-order repetitions occurred. The actual standalone verifier was compiled and replayed, returning RESULT N<=200 CLASSES=31060953 COLLISIONS=0. A separate Python checker compared the spine formula to literal proper-coloring enumeration on all four-spine types of order at most eight and checked larger reversal instances (40 exact checks). Polynomial equality implies congruence of both evaluations, so their injectivity certifies polynomial separation. No unbounded inference is made.
